name: emu-dm-desync
description: Reproduces the stale one-sided DM-session bug (issue this rig exists to catch) and exercises the #138 self-heal. A DMs B ('DM ALPHA') and the session establishes (asserted: ALPHA renders on B). B then reboots (EMU_REBOOT_AT_MS) losing its session half while A keeps its stale session; A keeps DMing ('DM BETA'), so B logs 'Failed session decrypt' (the desync symptom) and then 'DM session desync ... re-initiating handshake (self-heal)' (the #138 receiver-side heal). run_scenarios.sh asserts the ALPHA screen render plus both log signatures. The full heal-and-redeliver completes (A also tears down its stale session and a later BETA decrypts), but that end-to-end redelivery has run-to-run wall-clock variance in real-time mode, so CI gates on the deterministic symptom+heal-trigger rather than the final BETA render.
